title: Free Move-In Truck: Class Terms for the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Fleet
content:
The free move-in truck that comes with a Bluegate storage unit can be used only on a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental class marked eligible below. For each class the offer terms also give the miles included at no charge on a free move-in rental and the number of calendar days before or after a storage unit move-in date within which the free move-in truck may be picked up.

| Vehicle class | Eligible for the free move-in truck | Included miles on a free move-in rental | Pickup window around the move-in date (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | Yes | 50 | 7 |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | Yes | 50 | 7 |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck | Yes | 50 | 7 |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | Yes | 50 | 7 |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck | No | 0 | 7 |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | No | 0 | 7 |

## Points of reading

- The four smaller classes, from the Bluegate Pickup Truck to the Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck, are eligible and include 50 miles; the 20 ft and 26 ft trucks are not eligible and include 0 miles.
- The window figure of 7 calendar days is the same on every class.
